_headline: BSE IS NOT COVERABLE FROM THIS ENVIRONMENT, AND -- unusually -- NOT BECAUSE OF robots.txt. BSE serves no robots.txt at all (the www host returns the SPA shell for /robots.txt; the api host returns 403), so nothing on BSE is robots-disallowed. Every obstacle measured is a transport-level block: the entire modern data surface sits behind api.bseindia.com, which returns Akamai 403 Access Denied on every path tried, including its own robots.txt. The legacy static download tree that would have carried dated bhavcopy archives is gone (404) and its host no longer resolves (NXDOMAIN). Consequently ZERO market-data bytes were captured, NO era boundary was measured, and NO column schema was obtained. The third party's BSE era dates (2022-08-17 / 2024-07-07) are NEITHER confirmed NOR refuted -- they remain untested claims.

_robots.rule_applied: See ROBOTS_EVIDENCE.json for the full verbatim bodies. Summary: www.bseindia.com/robots.txt = HTTP 200 text/html, 14287 B, the Angular SPA shell (no robots.txt exists); api.bseindia.com/robots.txt = HTTP 403 Akamai Access Denied (host refuses to serve robots.txt).
_robots.key_ruling: Nothing on BSE is excluded by a robots Disallow rule. RFC 9309 2.3.1.3 (4xx on robots.txt) and 2.3.1.4 (unparseable robots.txt) both mean 'no restrictions'. Therefore the exclusions in this fixture set are BLOCKED (WAF) or DEAD (404/NXDOMAIN) -- never ROBOTS-DISALLOWED. This matters for the next session: retrying BSE from a non-datacentre client IP is compliant and legitimate, because no BSE path was ever robots-forbidden.

https://www.bseindia.com/robots.txt.verdict: NO robots.txt. SPA shell served for /robots.txt. Re-fetched at end of probe: byte-identical.

https://api.bseindia.com/robots.txt.verdict: NO robots.txt. Akamai 'Access Denied'. Re-fetched at end of probe: still 403.

https://www1.bseindia.com/robots.txt.verdict: NXDOMAIN. No request sent. BSE's legacy download host is decommissioned.

https://data.bseindia.com/robots.txt.verdict: Resolves to 43.228.177.9 but nothing listens on :443 (TCP connect failed, 22598 ms). No request sent.

_structural_finding_bse_vs_nse.statement: BSE has no public bulk-file host. NSE's coverage works partly because nsearchives.nseindia.com serves dated CSVs with NO robots.txt and no WAF, so an entire historical archive is cheaply crawlable. BSE has no analogue.
_structural_finding_bse_vs_nse.evidence: DNS enumeration (zero HTTP cost) of 20 candidate BSE hostnames: archives./archive./static./cdn./www1./www2./bhavcopy./nsearchives./api2./bseapi./connect./hsed. -- ALL NXDOMAIN. Only www., api., data. (dead), search. and membership. resolve.
_structural_finding_bse_vs_nse.consequence: Every BSE capability would have to come through one Akamai-fronted API host, including anything historical. If BSE does serve dated bhavcopy files, they are generated by that API rather than sitting as static files on a crawlable host -- so the NSE-derived mental model of 'walk the archive backwards' likely does not transfer to BSE.
_structural_finding_bse_vs_nse.edge_evidence: www and api share Akamai IPs 2.16.106.141/153 but have different edge configs (www: 200 on unknown paths; api: 403 on every path). The api response header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://www.bseindia.com/,https://api.bseindia.com', plus the SPA's dns-prefetch and rel=preconnect to api.bseindia.com, identify api.bseindia.com as the sole intended data origin.

_route_discrimination_method.why_needed: www.bseindia.com/robots.txt returned 200 HTML, which looked like a universal catch-all. If every path returned the SPA shell, status codes would be useless as evidence that a route is dead.
_route_discrimination_method.control_probe: GET https://www.bseindia.com/env.js (a real static asset referenced by the SPA shell) returned HTTP 200, application/javascript, 73 B.
_route_discrimination_method.conclusion: www serves genuine static files with correct Content-Type when they exist; its 404s are TRUE 404s, not a rewrite fallback. (A miss returns a 8255-8257 B custom IIS error page, distinct from the 14287 B SPA shell.) This makes the two 404s on /downloads1/Equity/ meaningful evidence of a removed tree rather than an artefact.

_units_determination.turnover: NOT DETERMINED. No BSE market-data file was ever obtained, so there is no cell to measure and no way to state a unit. Explicitly NOT inferred from an unverified header, and NOT carried over from NSE's lakhs/crores rules -- BSE is a different exchange and its units must never be assumed to match. This remains an open question requiring a successful fetch.
_units_determination.method_to_use_when_unblocked: Measure, do not read the label. Take one row with a known price and a known public share count, compute price x shares, and compare against the reported value across the plausible candidates (INR / INR lakh / INR crore). A mismatch by a constant power of ten across several liquid scrips identifies the scale.

third_party_claims.status: TREATED AS CLAIMS ONLY. The repository was NOT fetched and NOTHING was copied from it. It is a source of hypotheses to be re-derived from BSE itself.
other_claims: BSE delivery data is matched by security code (NSE uses SYMBOL + SERIES)
BSE published no separate delivery report before 2006-01-02
BSE index turnover is not published (left empty, never zero)

_era_boundaries.measured_by_this_probe: NOTHING. Zero BSE data files were retrievable, so no era boundary could be measured. This probe therefore neither confirms nor contradicts any of the above.
_era_boundaries.important_caveat_carried_forward: Per the NSE precedent in this repo, a stated cutover can be a conservative authorial choice rather than a schema boundary -- bfinance's nse/bhavcopy.py uses UDIFF_CUTOFF = 2024-01-01 while the third party claims an 8 July 2024 NSE cutover, and BOTH NSE URLs were verified to resolve for 2024-03-15. The same scepticism must be applied to BSE: when these routes become reachable, test whether each stated BSE era boundary is a real schema change or merely a preference, by fetching one date on each side of the boundary and diffing the real headers. Do not encode a cutover date that has not been measured.

_capability_verdicts.note: Ranked. BLOCKED = host reachable but refuses; DEAD = route/host does not exist; both are non-robots. UNPROBED = no request budget remained; treat as unknown, not as absent.

BSE_equity_bhavcopy_any_era.measured: api.bseindia.com 403 on 3 distinct paths (robots.txt, ListofScripData, FpiLimit). No archive file on www (404 x2).

BSE_index_bhavcopy.measured: No index request was made. The NSE-style claim that BSE index turnover is unpublished remains untested.

BSE_delivery_percentages.measured: No delivery request was made. BSE delivery lives on the same api host, so it is presumed to share the host-wide 403, but this is INFERRED, not measured.

BSE_scrip_codes_and_ISIN_universe.measured: ListofScripData 403. Cannot answer how many instruments, whether SME/ILP segments are included, or whether an ISIN column exists.

BSE_FPI_foreign_ownership_limit_and_util.measured: FpiLimit 403. This was the single most promising capability in the whole probe: it is exactly the data NSE's /api/quote-equity hides behind an Akamai 403 and that bfinance is therefore known to lack. BSE appears to expose the same information through the same class of public API, so a session with unblocked egress should prioritise it. Unverifiable from here.

BSE_trading_holiday_calendar.measured: No request made. BSE's holiday list is a published page/PDF on www, which IS reachable; this is the most likely capability to be recoverable and should be the first attempt by a future session.

legacy_static_EOD_archives.measured: /downloads1/Equity/ 404 under both EOD_DDMMYYYY.zip and EODDDMMYYYY.zip naming; host www1 NXDOMAIN.

_fixtures_captured.note: This fixture set contains NO market data. Every file is either a block or a dead-route recording. They are stored deliberately as evidence, per the instruction to keep negatives -- a future session should be able to assert 'BSE returned 403 on this exact path' without re-spending an IP reputation that BSE may not forgive.

positive_recordings.note: The only HTTP 200 body that is not an error page. A stub: window.__env.SERVER_IP = ['24', '']. Contains NO API base URL, so it was a dead end for route discovery -- but it is the control that proved www serves real static files.

negative_recordings.records: BSE serves no robots.txt on its primary host; /robots.txt returns the SPA shell.
api.bseindia.com refuses to serve its own robots.txt (Akamai 403).
End-of-probe re-fetch, same 403, proving the block is stable rather than transient. (sha differs from the earlier copy only in the Akamai Reference id embedded in the error page.)
Scrip-code/universe route blocked. Also the evidence that sending a well-formed Origin/Referer does not get past the edge.
The FPI limit route -- the capability that would have filled bfinance's known NSE gap -- is blocked.
Legacy /downloads1/Equity/EODDDMMYYYY.zip (no-underscore variant) is also gone, ruling out a simple naming-convention miss.

_no_market_data_captured: Confirmed. There is no CSV, ZIP, JSON market payload, and therefore no column schema, in this directory. Any future code that needs a BSE schema must obtain it from a successful, unblocked fetch; it must not be guessed from the third-party project's GPL source.
